name: Imponte Ruiner '82
summary: A 1980s Imponte muscle car modelled on the Pontiac Trans Am and Chevrolet Camaro.
body: GTABase lists the Imponte Ruiner '82 as a muscle car based on the Pontiac Trans Am and Chevrolet Camaro, with Muscle as its specialist shop.
GTABase gives it two seats, rear-wheel drive and five gears, a registration cost of $6,400, no tracker and a stolen sell value of $1,925.
GTABase notes the Ruiner name has appeared in GTA V and GTA IV.
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 4.5, Acceleration 4.6, Asphalt handling 3.7, Off-road handling 4.1, Strength 3.0, as read by GTABase only so far.

facts.price: $6,400 (Story Mode price, which the guides read as the registration cost)
facts.customise: Specialist tag "Muscle" (GTABase) matches the Muscle specialty shop: Capri Classic
facts.menu_text: Iconic coupe with unmistakable 1980s design and pop-up headlights.

name: Vapid Slamvan '56
summary: A rat-rodded 1950s Vapid pickup that GTABase files under muscle cars.
body: GTABase lists the Vapid Slamvan '56 as a muscle car based on a rat-rodded 1953-1956 Ford F-Series pickup, with Hot Rods as its specialist shop.
GTABase gives it two seats, rear-wheel drive and four gears, a registration cost of $17,500, a standard tracker and a stolen sell value of $5,225.
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 3.2, Acceleration 3.1, Asphalt handling 3.2, Off-road handling 3.4, Strength 3.0, as read by GTABase only so far.

name: Albany DeVanity '59
summary: A 1959 Albany coupe modelled on the Cadillac Eldorado, new to the series.
body: GTABase lists the Albany DeVanity '59 as a coupe based on the 1959 Cadillac Eldorado and says it is new to the series in GTA VI.
GTABase names Lowriders as its specialist shop and gives it two seats, a registration cost of $21,750, a standard tracker and a stolen sell value of $6,490.
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 4.4, Acceleration 4.5, Asphalt handling 3.2, Off-road handling 4.2, Strength 3.0, as read by GTABase only so far.

facts.price: $21,750 (Story Mode price, which the guides read as the registration cost)

facts.menu_text: An icon of 1950s Americana. Flamboyant and stylish. May have modern security features.

name: Schyster Woodland '85
summary: A wood-panelled 1980s Schyster wagon modelled on the Chrysler LeBaron Town & Country.
body: GTABase lists the Schyster Woodland '85 under sedans, based on the 1986-1988 Chrysler LeBaron Town & Country station wagon, and says it is new to the series.
GTABase names Donks as its specialist shop and gives it four seats, a registration cost of $7,400, no tracker and a stolen sell value of $2,200.
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 3.8, Acceleration 3.4, Asphalt handling 3.3, Off-road handling 3.4, Strength 3.0, as read by GTABase only so far.

name: Bravado Buffalo '19
summary: A modern Bravado muscle sedan modelled on the 2015 Dodge Charger.
body: GTABase lists the Bravado Buffalo '19 as a muscle car based on the 2015 Dodge Charger, with Tuner as its specialist shop and liveries available.
GTABase gives it four seats, rear-wheel drive and eight gears, a registration cost of $11,250, a standard tracker and a stolen sell value of $3,555.
It is separate from the '07 Bravado Buffalo already in the app.
In-game stat bars (out of 10): Speed 5.5, Acceleration 6.4, Asphalt handling 4.7, Off-road handling 4.4, Strength 3.0, as read by GTABase only so far.

facts.price: $11,250 (Story Mode price, which the guides read as the registration cost)

name: Annis Venturas BLVD Elegy '90
summary: A widebody tuned Elegy '90 given to GTA+ members from Chapter 3.
body: GTABase describes the Venturas BLVD Elegy '90 as a GTA+ exclusive: a specially tuned Elegy '90 with a widebody design.
GTABase says the GTA+ menu offers it together with the GTA+ Crosstown Garage as the Venturas BLVD Elegy & Garage, and that both unlock on reaching Chapter 3 with an active membership.
GTABase gives it two seats, all-wheel drive and five gears, and names the Nissan Skyline GT-R as its real-world basis.
